window_duration.title: Decode window (seconds)
window_duration.description: Fixed analysis window. Offset plus duration must fit inside the four-second stimulus.

offset_time.title: Trigger offset (seconds)
offset_time.description: Post-trigger samples to skip before the analysis window; this is not a phase calibration.

min_score.title: Minimum FBCCA similarity
min_score.description: Reject lower normalized weighted squared correlations. This score is not a calibrated probability.

min_margin.title: Minimum winner margin
min_margin.description: Required absolute difference between the two highest similarities. Exact ties always abstain.
